How to play

Learn it in two minutes.

Pick a game. Word is the one to start with.

Players 3–15Imposters up to halfHint on or off

    Set it up

    Tap Word. Pick players, imposters and hint, then START. Use one imposter for your first game.

  2. 2
    Pass it around

    The box names who's next. Hold the button to see your card, let go, then tap Next.

  3. 3
    Read your card

    Crew see the word. The imposter sees a hint, never the word. Everyone sees the category.

Who wins

Crew

You vote out every imposter.

Imposters

They survive the vote, or name the word.

More rules

Good clues

Don't say the word. Too obvious and the imposter figures it out. Too vague and you look guilty.

Hint off

The imposter only gets the category. Much harder.

Last chance (optional)

If the imposter is voted out but can name the word, they win anyway. Decide before you start.

New game

Keeps your setup and deals a fresh word. No word repeats within 16 rounds.

    The play screen

  4. 4
    Tag

    Only imposters tag. Tagged? Lie down right where you are. That's a body.

  5. 5
    Meet

    Find a body, or call an emergency meeting. Everyone gathers, talks, then votes. The phone game runs the vote and counts out who's voted out.

  6. 6
    3, 2, 1, UP!

    End every meeting with it. Everyone lying down gets up together, then no tagging for 15 seconds. The phone game counts it down.

Tag cooldown

After a tag, the imposter taps the right tile and waits for zero before tagging again.

3–6 players45 sec
7–10 players30 sec
11–15 players20 sec

Plus 10 seconds for each imposter after the first.

Who wins

Crew

Every imposter is voted out.

Imposters

There are at least as many imposters left as crew.

More rules

Body or emergency meeting

A body meeting is free, as many as you want. Emergency meetings come from the shared count on the box. The phone game also lets you cap how many any one player can call, and asks who's calling each one.

Fake deaths

Anyone can lie down without being tagged, to bait or confuse. Fakers get up at the end of the next meeting.

Out? You're a ghost

Tagged or voted out, go quiet and step off the play area. Never say who tagged you.

Voting

Every meeting ends in a vote: point at once on three, most votes is out. It's the only way crew get imposters out.

Voting on the phone

Pass the phone, or vote on your own in Play together. Tap a name, then Submit. Not sure? Skip. A tie, or more skips than votes, means nobody's out. Got tagged? Pick I got tagged on your ballot.

Play together

Everyone on their own phone. In Play, tap Play together.

Start a party

One person taps Host and gets a 4-letter code. Send the invite in Messages or Mail. Tapping it opens the game; they type a name and they're in. Or they tap Join and type the code.

No phone?

The host taps Add, and that player looks at their card on the host's phone.

Far apart

In Word, set Where is everyone? to Far apart. Everyone types a clue on their turn, then votes on their phone. One imposter, and it needs internet.

Tag

Anyone calls a meeting or reports a body from their own phone, and everyone votes on theirs.
